entities.summary: "Abdel Kader" is an Algerian traditional song made famous by the Algerian raï artist Khaled. It invokes the aid of the late 11th/early 12th century Sufi mystic and saint Abdul Qadir Gilani. It is featured on his 1993 studio album N'ssi N'ssi. After his 1993 original album version, Khaled released a solo live version of "Abdel Kader" in his live album Hafla in 1998.
